description_en: Updates the skill group information in the Cloud Customer Service System based on the AICCS instance ID and skill group ID. You can update the description and display name of the skill group
description_zh: 根据AICCS实例ID、技能组ID更新悉犀客服工作台技能组信息。支持更新技能组描述、技能组对外显示名称
name: UpdateSkillGroup

parameters.help_en: The AICCS instance ID. You can obtain the ID from the Instance Management page in the left-side navigation pane of the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)
parameters.help_zh: AICCS实例ID。 您可以在智能联络中心控制台 (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)左侧导航栏的实例管理中获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The skill group ID. You can call the QuerySkillGroups (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/aiccs/developer-reference/api-aiccs-2019-10-15-queryskillgroups) operation and view the SkillGroupId response parameter to obtain the skill group ID.

This parameter cannot be updated
parameters.help_zh:
技能组ID。

可调用QuerySkillGroups (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/aiccs/developer-reference/api-aiccs-2019-10-15-queryskillgroups)接口，查看返回参数的SkillGroupId，即技能组ID。

不支持更新
parameters.name: skill_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The skill group name.
This parameter cannot be updated
parameters.help_zh:
技能组名称。
不支持更新
parameters.name: skill_group_name

parameters.help_en:
The skill group description.
This parameter can be updated
parameters.help_zh:
技能组描述。
此参数支持更新
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The display name of the skill group.
This parameter can be updated
parameters.help_zh:
技能组对外显示名称。
此参数支持更新
parameters.name: display_name

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the client request. This parameter is used for idempotence verification and can be generated by using a UUID
parameters.help_zh: 客户请求唯一ID。用于幂等校验，可以用UUID生成
parameters.name: client_token

Code.description_en: The status code. A value of Success indicates that the request is successful
Code.description_zh: 状态码。返回Success表示请求成功

Message.description_en: The description of the status code

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the operation was called successfully. Valid values:
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
调用接口是否成功。取值：
true：成功。
false：失败
